name: Margaret
source:
Margaret is [url=/c164875]Igor's[/url] loyal assistant in Persona 4 and both [url=/c52191]Elizabeth[/url] and [url=/c164878]Theodore's[/url] older sister. Compared to her younger siblings, she is very composed and mature - though she does share her sister's humor. 

[Edited from [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Margaret]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]
